hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { cmd=$(cat); r1='(^|&&|\|\||;|\|)[[:space:]]*(mise[[:space:]]+env|env)([[:space:]]|$)'; r2='(^|&&|\|\||;|\|)[[:space:]]*(printenv|set|export)[[:space:]]*(&&|\|\||;|\||$)'; r3='(^|&&|\|\||;|\|)[[:space:]]*declare[[:space:]]+-x[[:space:]]*(&&|\|\||;|\||$)'; if [[ "$cmd" =~ $r1 ]] || [[ "$cmd" =~ $r2 ]] || [[ "$cmd" =~ $r3 ]]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: this command contains an environment-dump invocation (env, mise env, printenv, set, or export with no target, or declare -x with no assignment) somewhere in the chain -- these print every secret in plaintext regardless of position. Use mise exec -- <command>, mise run <task>, or read a single named variable instead."}}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { cmd=$(cat); if [[ -z "$cmd" ]] || [[ "$cmd" =~ (^|&&|\|\||;)[[:space:]]*cd([[:space:]]+[^&|;]*)?[[:space:]]*$ ]] || [[ "$cmd" =~ (^|[^\<])\<\<[^\<] ]]; then printf '{}'; else jq -n --arg cmd "set -o pipefail; ${cmd} 2>&1 | '$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/redact-secrets'" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","updatedInput":{"command":$cmd}}}'; fi; }
